definition: Agitation is a state of restlessness marked by unpleasant feelings of irritability and tension. It can occur in connection with problems such as pain, stress, fever, substance withdrawal or drug use, depression, bipolar disorders, and schizophrenia.

provenance.scope: Source record C79530; pinned source text

reasons: The definition uses broader categories (“substance withdrawal or drug use”) than what the packet explicitly lists (specifically “alcohol and nicotine withdrawal” and “cocaine and hallucinogenic drugs use”).

The definition’s cause list includes terms (“substance withdrawal” / “drug use”) that are not directly supported by the packet’s specific wording, making part of the definition an unsupported generalization.

The definition broadens the packet’s causes beyond support by saying “substance withdrawal” and “drug use”; the packet specifies only alcohol and nicotine withdrawal, and cocaine and hallucinogenic drugs use.
The rest of the definition is generally supported, but the unsupported causal generalization is enough to fail under the requested standard.
